page.overview:
Who is Tar-Telperiën?

Tar-Telperiën was the tenth ruler and second Ruling Queen of Númenor. She succeeded her father King Tar-Súrion.

Tar-Telperiën ruled for 175 years. During her reign, the Rings of Power were forged, and Sauron conquered Eriador. She did little to react to these events. She refused to marry and bore no children. She was succeeded by Tar-Minastir, the son of her younger brother, Isilmo. She died in the year SA 1731 at the age of 411.

The name Telperiën might be related to the Quenya tyelpë ("silver") and -ien, a feminine suffix.

She was most likely named after Telperion, the White Tree of Valinor.
